::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Whitefield) IP firm founded by Basheer Boddikonda. Licenses high-speed controller IP, customised for FPGAs and hardened for ASICs; says its cores are silicon-proven on TSMC 28nm to 3nm.
:::

## What does this firm design?

PCIe, CXL, DDR, Ethernet and USB4 controller IP cores; FPGA customisation and ASIC hardening.
